description: This file defines a React hook named useProjectCost that fetches and formats the aggregated cost of a project from a backend API. It manages state for data, loading, and error, and provides a method to refetch the data. The hook normalizes the project ID, constructs the API URL, handles fetch responses, and formats the cost for display.

methods.name: useProjectCost
methods.description: React hook that fetches and formats the project cost from the backend API, managing loading and error states, and providing a refetch method.
